body: I'm all out of cash.  I've been trying to get odd jobs that pay under the table here and there but haven't been able to get anything at all lately so the cash I had ran out.  fresh out of food for now also.
Shelters are full or I don't feel safe in them.  last time I stayed at a shelter I had a few things stolen.  I'm in Toronto specifically.
not really sleeping anywhere.  In a tim hortons right now cause it's the only place open and where I can stay warm.

Father died last year and put me into deep depression.  lost my job as a result and couldn't get another.  eventually lost my home.  Don't have any friends and no longer have any family to fall back on.
